text:
sophia: Heads up — noticed a bunch of exported scorecards from yesterday's panel go out with interviewer_name empty and interviewer_id set to 'anon-<hash>'.
kevin: Whoa, that's the anonymize_experiment flag rollout? @ana did you toggle that last night? :eyes:
ana: Yep I toggled anonymize mode for the pilot in staging -> prod via the admin console at 23:42 PST. I thought it only affected the UI display tokens, not CSV export. :facepalm:
james: Confirmed on a sample export. CSV header shows interviewer_name blank, interviewer_email blank, interviewer_id = anon-XXXX. Here's the quick SQL I ran to reproduce: ```select id, interviewer_id, interviewer_name from scorecards where created_at > '2026-03-22' limit 5;```
sophia: This broke our bulk feedback ingest for hiring teams — they can't map scores to people. Need triage: can we revert toggle and backfill real interviewer identifiers into exports?
ana: I'm reverting the flag now. Will ping deploybot. @kevin can you check whether the anonymize transform is applied at export layer or earlier in the API?
kevin: Investigating. From a quick look it's in the export service transform pipeline — it was wired to respect the feature flag. If we revert the flag it should stop new exports, but already-exported CSVs are affected. We can backfill by joining audit logs to map anon IDs -> real IDs (audit_event stores original mapping).
james: We should also run a one-off backfill job and attach fixed CSVs to the original ticket. I'm happy to run the job if you give me the query.
ana: TY. Revert done — deploybot: deploy anonymize-feature-toggle -> prod (rollback). :white_check_mark:
deploybot: deploybot: Started rollback of anonymize-feature-toggle to version v2.1.3 by ana. ETA ~ 30s.
deploybot: deploybot: Successfully rolled back anonymize-feature-toggle to v2.1.3.
kevin: Revert confirmed. Exports now include names. I'll open an ops ticket with the backfill plan and steps. Draft plan: 1) query audit_event for anon->user_id mapping; 2) update scorecards where interviewer_id like 'anon-%'; 3) regenerate CSVs and upload to ticket; 4) notify affected hiring managers. Any objections?
sophia: No objections. Please add runbook link and cc recruiting@redwood.com. Also include timeframe estimate.
kevin: Added runbook link: <https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/exports-backfill>. ETA 2hrs to run job + validation.
james: :thumbsup: I'll queue the job after approval from CS. Also a suggestion — add export integration test to catch anonymized outputs.
ana: Agree — adding test and a feature flag guard so export pipeline only respects anonymize in UI mode. I'll follow up PR.
sophia: Thanks all. Can we get a quick message to hiring-managers with apology + timelines?
kevin: Drafted DM and will send after CSVs are regenerated.
